children: Friedman Industries entered into a Seventh Amendment to its Amended and Restated Credit Agreement to expand total revolving credit commitments from $140 million to $200 million. JPMorgan Chase Bank, as administrative agent, and a syndicate of lenders remain parties to the facility. The amendment also makes conforming changes to threshold amounts. Management said the expansion aligns the credit facility with growth in the company’s borrowing base and supports ongoing operations.
